propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but logically belong in the store layer and are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency
Moving the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py eliminates the inverted dependency and reduces coupling between command-layer and diagnostic-layer modules
Compatibility surfaces must be preserved: fsck.py continues re-exporting _ticket_dirs and _resolve_tracker_git_dir; fsck_repair.py keeps module-level bindings of all three names for test patches
The move preserves gitutil.py as a stdlib-only leaf module with no module-level rebar imports, keeping the import graph acyclic
All seven consumers (fsck_scan, fsck, gitutil, fsck_recover, compact, bridge_repair, tracker_maintenance) are repointed to import from gitutil instead of fsck_repair
No test files are edited; existing test suite runs unmodified and verifies the move through structural assertions (AC1-AC7) and gate checks (AC8-AC12)
